code: (function() { try { var comp = app.project.activeItem; if (!(comp instanceof CompItem)) return 'ERROR: Open and select your composition first.'; var calf = null; var yearling = null; for (var i = 1; i <= comp.numLayers; i++) { var l = comp.layer(i); var n = l.name.toLowerCase(); if (n.indexOf('calf') !== -1 && !calf) calf = l; if (n.indexOf('yearling') !== -1 && !yearling) yearling = l; } if (!calf) return 'ERROR: Could not find layer containing "calf".'; if (!yearling) return 'ERROR: Could not find layer containing "yearling".'; app.beginUndoGroup('Morph Calf into Yearling'); var t0 = comp.time; var t1 = t0 + 2.0; calf.property('Opacity').setValueAtTime(t0, 100); calf.property('Opacity').setValueAtTime(t1, 0); yearling.property('Opacity').setValueAtTime(t0, 0); yearling.property('Opacity').setValueAtTime(t1, 100); if (yearling.inPoint > t0) yearling.inPoint = t0; app.endUndoGroup(); return 'SUCCESS: Morphed "' + calf.name + '" into "' + yearling.name + '" over 2 seconds!'; } catch(e) { return 'ERROR: ' + e.toString(); } })();
